core_offer.name: Acme Route Planner
core_offer.one_liner: Route planning software that builds daily delivery routes for regional fleets.
core_offer.outcome: Dispatchers stop building routes by hand and drivers get clear daily plans.

icp.icp_text: Regional delivery and distribution companies in the US running their own fleet of 20 or more vans or trucks.
icp.negate_icp_text: Freight brokers, logistics software vendors, consulting firms

pains.pain: Routes are planned by hand in spreadsheets every morning
pains.cost_of_inaction: Hours of dispatcher time every day and late starts for drivers

pains.pain: No clear view of cost per stop
pains.cost_of_inaction: Pricing and expansion decisions are made on guesses
Payroll creeps up and drivers burn out

front_end_offers.name: Free route teardown
front_end_offers.what_they_get: We re-plan one day of their real routes and show the side-by-side
front_end_offers.cta: Want me to run one day of your routes through it?

front_end_offers.name: Cost-per-stop calculator
front_end_offers.what_they_get: A simple sheet that shows their cost per stop from numbers they already have

front_end_offers.name: Dispatcher morning checklist
front_end_offers.what_they_get: A one-page checklist for planning routes faster tomorrow morning

proof_points.claim: Case study with Example Freight Co on moving from spreadsheets to automated routes
